_file_role: DISCOVERY CONFIG ONLY. Declares what to search for and where. Canonical tracking state lives in data/products.json; historical observations live in data/price-history.json; rejected matches and evidence live in research/.

identity_rules.rule: A product may only enter data/products.json if it has a manufacturer part number confirmed from a manufacturer or retailer product page. Marketing titles are search aids only, never keys.
identity_rules.no_part_number: Products discovered without a part number go to research/unresolved.json and are NOT tracked or published.

retailer_notes.uk.store.asus.com: Readable. Full spec table includes Model Number and Part Number. Primary identity source for ASUS.
retailer_notes.laptopoutlet.co.uk: Readable. Full spec table with SKU and part number. Must check stock status; exclude out_of_stock from lowest_verified.
retailer_notes.argos.co.uk: BLOCKED. HTTP 403 at Akamai edge. Confirmed by direct fetch and via Jina Reader. Do not retry aggressively.
retailer_notes.ao.com: Listing discovery works; page fetch returned CRAWL_UNKNOWN_ERROR via the current backend. Needs separate verification.
retailer_notes.amazon.co.uk: Marketplace listings. Aggregated 'from' prices are not current prices. Treat as UNVERIFIED until page read.
retailer_notes.johnlewis.com: Readable. Full spec table with MPN, price, stock status, and direct product URL. 2-year guarantee included.
retailer_notes.esupply.co.uk: Readable. Full spec table with Dell SKU and part number. Windows 11 Pro business SKU. Primary identity source for Dell Inspiron 3530.

fetch_strategies.note: Record BLOCKED with block_reason; do not attempt evasion.
